Third-party license for the Sass sources in this directory
==========================================================

Component
---------

    Bootstrap — the Sass source only. The matching compiled JavaScript is a
    separate vendored copy at
    `../mod-script-assets/card-mod-bootstrap/vendor/bootstrap/`, and carries
    its own license file beside its own bytes.

    Upstream: https://getbootstrap.com/   (source: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap)
    Files:    ./_*.scss and the subdirectories forms/, helpers/, mixins/,
              utilities/, vendor/

Copyright
---------

**None of the vendored Sass files states a copyright line.** They open with
Sass comments describing the partial (`_variables.scss` begins
`// Variables`, followed by a comment about the
`$component-state-property-size` formula and `// Color system`). The upstream
project is named here from the files' own embedded metadata — the Bootstrap
SCSS variable names and section comments throughout, and this directory's
position as the deck's Bootstrap Sass source tree. No copyright line is
stated, so none is asserted here.

License: the MIT License, reproduced in full below. Upstream publishes its
copy at https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/main/LICENSE.

Version
-------

Not stated in the vendored Sass files, and not claimed here. The compiled
JavaScript vendored beside it states `Bootstrap v5.1.3` in its own banner,
which is the version this Sass tree belongs to; that banner is the citation
for the version, not a claim made by these files.

Scope of the MIT grant inside this project
------------------------------------------

MIT is permissive and GPL-compatible, so vendoring these bytes does not
disturb this project's GPL-3.0-or-later scope (see NOTICE at the repository
root). The MIT terms require only that the notice above travel with the
software, which this file does; the vendored partials themselves carry no
banner, so this file is the only place the notice travels with them. Note
that the compiled CSS these partials produce is shipped concatenated inside
`scripts/deploy/one-click-deck/demo-static-assets/assets/all-style.css`;
that bundle's `PROVENANCE.md` restates this notice for the concatenation.
